original_manifest_entry.visual_description: Forked cloth standard beneath a hooded lantern, with asymmetric wax writ tabs and a heavy brass plumb weight.
Crooked antler-crowned reedwood totem with a hooked hide pennant, coarse chain loops, and hanging bone clappers.
Tall symmetrical ivory frame holding a diamond prism, split pennon, side mirror vanes, and orbiting calibration rings.
Living forked sapling standard with woven leafcloth, a spined thorn halo, graft clasps, and rooted seed weight.
Broad segmented metal gonfalon built around a round pressure gauge, warrant plates, furnace vents, and caliper feet.
Torn sailcloth stretched between curved ship ribs beneath a cracked bell, with a side lantern and chain keel.
Tall bridge-lock key built through a hooded glowing beacon, with side writ rolls, wax seals, and a hanging brass weight.
Crooked bog-hound jaw over a heavy patterned bell, flanked by two scent vials and a long hide tassel.
Symmetrical gold meridian frame around a large blue diamond lens, with two raised mirror vanes and a sun-point crown.
Leaf-pointed seed compass enclosed by four forked living roots, side leaves, thorn tips, and a rope carry loop.
Round black iron pressure dial with a bright red needle, furnace vents, folding brass sights, and a chain plumb.
Open crescent astrolabe around a pale hanging shard, with curved ship ribs, a cracked bell, and a narrow fogglass vial.

A broad chain loop is crossed by one vertical spear point and one offset long key, with three round seals hanging below.
A broad crescent drum is crossed by one long diagonal bone key and ends in three unequal hanging tassels.
Two overlapping tilted diamond panes rise above a short handle, with one narrow side vane and one crossing needle.
A triangular braided cradle holds three round stones and trails into one long curved cord with a leaf-shaped weight.
A wide U-shaped spur carries one square wheel, one round gauge, two unequal pointed pins, and a broad buckle strap.
A tall crescent frame holds one large hanging droplet, one offset bell, a forked side cord, and a narrow lower hook.
A broad bell is crossed by one long horizontal rod and carries three unequal hanging tags beside a square clapper.
Two split rails form a wide triangle around one lever, one toothed wheel, and a single round direction bead.
A large open crescent encloses a pointed star lens while three uneven forks and one long chain break its circular outline.
A tall shield lantern is crossed by one round millwheel and closes to a pointed base beneath a hooded flame.
A thick open spiral ends in a wide horn mouth and a forked handle, with two small teeth hanging from the inner coil.
A bulbous caged flask is crossed by one enormous hooked quill and carries three small seals below its stopper.
Seven unequal plates radiate from one round boss, creating a broken flower-like shield with two offset hinges.
Five broad fan vanes spread beneath one long piercing needle and a tiny arrow vane, with a single bead below.
A tall woven case holds three unequal bolt heads and is crossed by one narrow shuttle beside a strongly curved strap.
A long pointed ampoule is clasped by two leaf jaws and carries three round side chambers beneath a bent tube.
A long crooked pole carries one tightly folded triangular pennon, three round discs, and a narrow hooked lower tip.
A narrow cracked bell extends into one enormous lower hook and carries three small side chimes beneath a wave-shaped handle.
